method: view_image of time-ordered contact sheets decoded from all seven encoded MP4s, plus representative full-size images. 58 encoded frames across seven clips were actually inspected in time order. No continuous real-time video playback and no audio listening. Source-video review is separate.

Actor turns toward the player and approaches with head/chest/legs visible. Windup/attack bring face and shoulder close; after contact the solved apparatus is retained at the earned checkpoint. Later east retry completion is recorded in the full timeline.

Actual crank rotates and the running indicator changes; actor passes the bay opening around 2.2 seconds then leaves the framing. The evidence becomes investigate then search at the physical projector source.
Same physical initial runtime and camera changes without crank. Actor remains on patrol and passes the same opening at a different time; no invented sound-source movement.

From an actually walked legal pose, the handle and a broad portion of curtain are visible together. Brown lower edge descends between 1.1 and 2.13 seconds; walking to the exit subsequently completes the chapter.
